name: band lying hip external rotation
description: A side-lying clam-style move with a band around the knees that fires up the outer hip and glute muscles.
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and a loop band around your thighs just above the knees.
Keep your feet together and your hips stacked.
Rotate the top knee upward, opening like a clamshell.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch sides.
Keep your pelvis still so the movement comes from the hip.
